title: PrimeBOT Brings Personal Robotics to the UN's AI for Good Summit in Geneva
summary: PrimeBOT presented its vision of a Personal Robot at the UN’s AI for Good Summit in Geneva: a home-oriented robot category meant for everyday ownership, programming, and creative use rather than industrial automation. The emphasis was less on technical specifications than on positioning personal robotics as part of broader discussions around education, inclusion, and expanding human potential.

extra.full_text: PrimeBOT defines a new category: the Personal Robot – robots designed for homes and daily life, not production lines, that anyone can own, program, and create with. title: 2026 WRO 한국대회, 8월 8~9일 청주오스코서 열린다
summary: The 2026 World Robot Olympiad Korea will be held August 8–9 at Cheongju OSCO, bringing together students from elementary school through university for one of Korea’s largest smart-robot competitions. The event centers on robotics and AI creativity and technical skill, with backing from local government, education, culture, and robotics-industry organizations.

title: 미·중 BCI 전쟁, ‘두개골 뚫는’ 미국 vs ‘몸에 입히는’ 중국
summary: BCI is becoming a strategic technology battleground, with the U.S. and China pursuing sharply different routes to brain-controlled computers, robots, and prosthetics. The U.S. push is represented by Neuralink-style invasive implants that require opening the skull, while China is emphasizing noninvasive wearable systems that avoid surgery and could be easier to scale. AI matters because better signal interpretation is making these interfaces more practical, turning BCI from a lab capability into a competitive platform technology.

extra.full_text: 뇌와 컴퓨터를 직접 연결하는 뇌-컴퓨터 인터페이스(BCI)가 차세대 전략 기술로 부상하면서 미국과 중국의 경쟁도 치열해지고 있다는 분석이 나왔다. title: The Human Bottleneck in Healthcare Automation: Matching Doctors to Demand
summary: Hospitals are pairing background automation, from delivery robots to AI documentation and scheduling tools, with a harder operational problem: matching scarce doctors to uneven patient demand. The piece frames the remaining bottleneck as human allocation rather than software capability, where better forecasting and workflow coordination could reduce waiting and make care delivery feel smoother day to day.

extra.full_text: Hospitals have spent years trying to remove friction from care delivery. Routine administrative tasks are moving into software. Robots are moving supplies through corridors. title: 로비언트, 체화형 네이티브 월드 액션 모델 ‘링봇-VA 2.0’ 출시
summary: Ant Group’s Robbyant has released RingBot-VA 2.0, an embodied native world-action model designed from the ground up for robots operating in physical environments rather than adapted from digital content-generation models. The company frames it as a shift toward robotics foundation models that directly handle dynamic monitoring, causal prediction, and real-time execution in the physical world.

title: 미래컴퍼니, 몽골 국립 제1중앙병원에 ‘레보아이’ 두 번째 수출
summary: Mirae Company has exported its Revo-i surgical robot to Mongolia for the second time, supplying it to the 568-bed First Central Hospital of Mongolia in Ulaanbaatar. The hospital is one of Mongolia’s largest national tertiary centers and handles complex procedures including organ transplantation, so the placement signals Revo-i’s move beyond its earlier installation at Mongolia’s National Cancer Center into broader high-acuity surgical use.

title: 中 피지컬AI 기업 '엑스파크AI', 220억원 엔젤투자 유치
summary: China-based Xspark AI, a startup developing physical AI for robots, raised 100 million yuan, about 22.1 billion won, in its first angel round led by CDH VGC and SEE Fund with participation from other financial institutions. The funding will go toward R&D, product refinement, and large-scale commercialization, and the round signals growing investor appetite in China for AI systems that can operate through embodied robotic platforms.

extra.full_text: 중국에서 로봇을 위한 피지컬AI를 개발하는 스타트업이 200억원이 넘는 규모의 투자를 유치했다.10일 중국 로봇 전문 포털 중국로봇망에 따르면 피지컬 AI 기업 엑스파크AI(Xspark AI, 无界智航)가 1억위안(약 221억원) 규모의 첫 엔젤투자를 유치했다. 이 투자는 CDH(鼎晖VGC), 씨펀드(SEE Fund) 등 투자기관이 주도하고 여러 금융기관이 참여했다. 투자금은 기술 연구개발과 제품 개선, 피지컬 AI의 대규모 상용화에 주로 사용될 예정이다.매체는 이번 투자가 피지컬 AI 분야에 대한 투자 증가 추이를 보여주는 대표적
